name: Strato Apartment

facts_sl.lake: Kočevsko jezero je približno 270 m od apartmaja
facts_sl.checkin: Prijava od 15:00 (osebni sprejem ali samostojna prijava s kodo)

facts_sl.bedroom1: Velika spalnica z multimedijo, knjigami in ambientno osvetlitvijo
facts_sl.bedroom2: Manjša spalnica s TV in igralno konzolo Xbox ter dvema sedalnima vrečama
facts_sl.living: Dnevna soba s TV, klavirjem, kitaro in tolkali, otroškimi igračami in družabnimi igrami; neposreden izhod na teraso
facts_sl.bathroom: Kopalnica s tušem, pralni stroj, sušilec za lase, kozmetično ogledalo
facts_sl.climate: Ogrevanje s toplotno črpalko, klimatska naprava
facts_sl.outdoor: Terasa s senčnikom, vrt, prostor za žar
facts_sl.extras: Brezplačen WiFi, otroška posteljica, zasebni vhod, copati, dežniki, knjiga gostov
facts_sl.renovated: Leta 2025 v celoti prenovljen in posodobljen
facts_sl.languages: Govorimo slovensko, angleško, hrvaško in srbsko

facts_en.lake: Lake Kočevje is about 270 m from the apartment
facts_en.center: about 400 m to Kočevje town centre

facts_en.bedroom2: Smaller bedroom with a TV, an Xbox console and two bean bags
facts_en.living: Living room with TV, piano, guitar and percussion, children's toys and board games; direct access to the terrace
facts_en.bathroom: Bathroom with shower, washing machine, hair dryer, cosmetic mirror
facts_en.outdoor: Terrace with sunshade, garden, barbecue area

ratings._note: Hosts allowed us (26.11.2026, via owner) to use their Booking and Airbnb reviews. Use these 5 exactly; mark the source and 'prevedeno/translated' where shown. Do not edit or add reviews.
ratings.booking: 9,9 / 10 (10 ocen) – Izjemno; osebje 10, čistoča 10, udobje 10, lokacija 9,6

reviews.name: Christel
reviews.sl: Na poti v Budimpešto smo se ustavili pri Barbari in Roku za eno noč in našli pravi zaklad. Hiša je čudovita, okusno opremljena in ima zelo sproščujoče vzdušje. Terasa je miren prostor za branje ali obedovanje. Rok in Barbara sta bila zelo prijazna in proaktivna od prvih sporočil.
reviews.en: On our way to Budapest we stopped at Barbara and Rok's for one night and found a real treasure. The house is beautiful, tastefully furnished and very relaxing. The terrace is a quiet place for reading or dining. Rok and Barbara were very kind and proactive from the very first messages.

reviews.name: Sebastiano
reviews.sl: Bivanje je bilo neverjetno: stanovanje je 100 % skladno s fotografijami in opisom. Je toplo in prijetno, kot doma. Gostitelj je bil vedno na voljo. Toplo priporočam!
reviews.en: The stay was incredible: the apartment matches the photos and description 100%. It is warm and cosy, just like home. The host was always available. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Jana
reviews.sl: Čudovito, na novo prenovljeno stanovanje. Imelo je vse, kar smo potrebovali. Gostitelji so bili zelo prijazni.
reviews.en: A wonderful, newly renovated apartment. It had everything we needed. The hosts were very friendly.

reviews.name: Martin
reviews.sl: Nastanitev je bila zelo čista in moderno opremljena. Kljub poznemu prihodu ob 01:30 ponoči smo se še vedno udobno prijavili.
reviews.en: The accommodation was very clean and modern. Despite our late arrival at 01:30 at night we could still check in comfortably.
reviews.original: Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und modern eingerichtet. Trotz unserer verspäteten Ankunft um 01:30 in der Nacht konnten wir immer noch bequem Einchecken.

reviews.name: Cindy
reviews.sl: Zelo lepo, kakovostno in novo stanovanje s super prijaznima gostiteljema, v čudoviti pokrajini.
reviews.en: A very beautiful, high-quality new apartment with super friendly hosts, in wonderful countryside.
reviews.original: Sehr schönes hochwertiges und neues Apartment mit super freundlichen Vermietern, in einer tollen Landschaft.
